root_idea.summary: The root centers on exchange: giving something of value and receiving its countervalue. The terms of buying and selling may be viewed from either side of the exchange.
root_idea.development: The exchange sense extends to reciprocal bargaining and transactions, and figuratively to a covenant of allegiance in which obedience, persons, or property are pledged in return for a promised recompense.

qac_form_accounting.reason: The Quranic Form III verb has a distinct covenantal and allegiance usage.
The Quran attests the reciprocal transaction form independently.
The Quranic noun has commercial-exchange and covenantal-transaction usages.
The Quranic plural denotes churches; it is presented under the supported singular citation form.

senses.definition: To make a covenant of allegiance with someone; to pledge loyalty, submission, and obedience.
senses.usage_conditions: A reciprocal covenantal construction, especially allegiance pledged to a leader or to God. In the Quran, it is used of the pledges made to the Prophet and of the covenant referred to in the transaction imagery of 9:111.

senses.definition: To transact with one another; to buy and sell mutually.
senses.usage_conditions: A reciprocal commercial construction referring to the parties engaging in a sale or other exchange together.

senses.definition: A sale or commercial exchange of property; the transaction or contract by which value is exchanged for a countervalue.
senses.usage_conditions: The term may be viewed from the seller's or buyer's side, so sale and purchase can be expressed by the same exchange vocabulary. It covers Quranic references to trade, sale, and commercial business.

senses.definition: A covenantal transaction or pledge, figuratively framed as an exchange of persons and property for a promised divine recompense.
senses.usage_conditions: A Quran-specific figurative use, especially in 9:111, where the believers' pledge and God's promised reward are expressed through the language of sale and purchase.

quranic_forms.public_pos_label: Noun · plural form in the Quran

senses.definition: A church or Christian place of worship.
senses.usage_conditions: The Quranic form is the plural بِيَع, referring to churches or Christian houses of worship.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To sell; also, according to construction and perspective, to buy or to offer something for sale.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The verb may take the thing exchanged and the recipient, with مِنْ or لِ marking the other party; with لِ, it can mean to buy something for another. The same verb can therefore describe either side of the exchange.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To sell something against another person's will or without that person's consent.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A construction used of a judge or other authority selling against the affected person's wishes.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To slander or denounce someone to the Sultan.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A tropical idiomatic construction with مِنَ السُّلْطَانِ.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To supersede, overpower, or gain mastery over another; in a related idiom, to equal another.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A proverbial or tropical construction describing victory over a rival or taking the position and advantage sought by another.
A rare lexical usage recorded as equivalent to انبساط.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To barter or exchange commodities mutually.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: This is the commercial reciprocal use, distinct from the Quranic covenantal use of the Form III verb.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To become saleable or easy to sell; to have a ready sale.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A quasi-passive development from the exchange verb.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To ask someone to sell something to oneself.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The requested object is expressed as the thing one asks the other person to sell.

other_classical_meanings.definition: The hire or hiring of land.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A specialized nominal usage distinct from ordinary sale or purchase.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A thing sold or bought; also, a kind or type of sale or purchase.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Here the noun denotes the exchanged object or the varieties of commercial dealing, rather than the act or contract itself.

other_classical_meanings.definition: The striking or taking together of the hands of contracting parties to ratify a sale.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A formal gesture marking confirmation of the sale contract.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A covenant or oath of allegiance and obedience, and the act of submitting to it.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The term can denote the pledge itself, its obligations, or the formal act by which allegiance is undertaken.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A mode or manner of selling or buying.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A nominal description of how commercial dealing is conducted.
A concrete commercial item, with a plural used for articles of merchandise.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A person skilled in selling or buying.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The form has masculine and feminine uses and denotes proficiency in commercial dealing.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A person who sells or buys much.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: An intensive description of someone heavily engaged in selling or buying.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A seller or buyer; according to some usage, a bargainer or chafferer.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Without further restriction, the seller meaning is more obvious; in paired legal or commercial expressions it can denote the seller and buyer together.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A woman who readily obtains a suitor or is much sought after because of her beauty.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A tropical feminine use, explained figuratively as though she sold herself.
A passive participial form used of the result or object of the exchange.

cautions: بَاعَ and بَيْع can describe either side of an exchange; the intended direction is determined by construction and perspective.

The public headword بِيعَة represents the singular citation form of the Quranic plural بِيَع. The classical evidence records a secondary view extending this word to a Jewish synagogue, while the Quranic context supports churches.
